sections.appearance: Hiyori has long teal hair tied off into a side ponytail. Her eyes are a dull teal color, with the left eye being covered by her bangs. Halo ==== Hiyori’s halo is a pattern of alternating blue crosses and smaller teal crosses, forming a pentagonal shape on the halo's inner side. Uniform ==== Hiyori wears a dark grey long sleeve sweater with white collar, a white box pleated mini-skirt, a black belt at the waist, black thigh garter, black below-calf-length socks and black shoes. Hiyori also wears a white cape, a bit of the cape is pleated around her neck, and a black brando hat. Firearm ==== She uses a dark blue Mechem NTW-20 with light blue accents. The Arius logo is imprinted on the receiver. The school's motto is written on the barrel.

sections.personality: Hiyori is a petulant and melancholic member of the Arius Squad. She has low self-esteem, usually sees things in a negative light and is often self-deprecating when it comes to herself whether it's over the Squad's dire finances, or not getting to read her favorite magazines. She even cries and laments over her belly-button looking different from others. Appearance === Hiyori has long teal hair tied off into a side ponytail.
